checks.requirement: Resources, input isolation, Unicode and bounded target closure

Target dimensions are explicit and validated against GPU dimensions and 8.3MP; errors do not select lower quality. Qt GLB reader bounds input and preserves identity node transform. No drive/current-directory dependent product resource.

checks.requirement: Cross-backend shader, clip-space and pass closure
checks.evidence: MVP raster correction uses QRhi; shadow canonical coordinates retain source convention. Texture Y, Vogel offsets and IGN are transformed together. Shadow receiver normal/depth bias and back-face caster are explicit; no simultaneous target read/write. Standard std140 560-byte block and device-aligned offsets match reflection. GLSL/ES/HLSL/MSL variants are generated with actual qsb. Three source PCFSoft alias resolves to 5 Vogel samples. Raw diagnostics are single-sample; capture resolve/mips/shell and postprocess are clearly assigned to R10B/C, not falsely passed.

checks.requirement: GUI/render isolation, target rebuild, readback and teardown
checks.evidence: synchronize copies only immutable values, detach image; render retains no GUI item/provider pointer. Renderer owns all QRhi resources; target reset destroys binding/pipeline first then target/pass/attachments. Async results retain storage and weak completion references; finish drains outstanding GPU work before storage teardown. GUI queued receiver is QPointer-guarded and captured result storage is shared through destruction. request filtering prevents older delivery replacing newer snapshot. 30 target changes while readbacks are queued passed on Windows. No media command, network provider or playback lifecycle changes.

checks.evidence: Current Quick3D run uses R07 paper shader, R03 imported mesh and R09 independent geometry prepass; the RHI side parses source GLB and renders its own MRT. Paired images freeze same input and wait on frames/readbacks, not sleep. GPU corners <=2px and known front plane error are checked independently. Source shadow witnesses 9-20 are hashed with fixture; white receiver domain is declared, full material ROI acceptance remains R10B. Complete Review and production regression/QML lint reports retained. No claim that MSAA, tile transfer budget, final performance or other platform runtime passed.
